summary: Robert B. 'Glider Bob' Saunders, 64, Telluride local and owner/operator of Glide Telluride, died with passenger Ronald Ueckert, 66, when Saunders' Stemme S10-VT motorglider went down for an unknown reason in Prospect Basin, Telluride Ski area, around 2 p.m.; SAR personnel helped extricate the victims
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office; San Miguel County SAR; Telluride Fire Protection District EMS; San Miguel County Coroner
notes: Wednesday-verified. Dispatch 2:11 p.m.; deputies + Telski employees confirmed the crash; both victims found pulseless, resuscitation unsuccessful; NTSB/FAA notified. Passenger Ronald Ueckert, 66, per Accident Data Center. Run-910 San Miguel County SO alerts mining; subagent opened the alert live (2026-09-18); parent search-corroborated via AOPA, SnowBrains, Kathryn's Report NTSB factual.
